items.title: A minimal quasi-compact subset mapping onto a quasi-compact space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a continuous surjection onto a quasi-compact space there is a quasi-compact subset mapping onto the target and minimal with that property (author lemma at source lines 5502-5508, label lemma-find-compact-subset). The proof (source lines 5510-5527) orders the quasi-compact subsets mapping onto the target by inclusion and applies Zorn's lemma, checking that the intersection of a totally ordered subfamily is quasi-compact as a closed subset and still maps onto the target by the finite intersection criterion (proof lines 5510-5526). The Zorn argument is the substance. H3.
